description: Settings.py AEROBIM_* knobs intentionally absent from README ## Configuration. Aliases, lab-only, and operator-internal limits. Operator-facing knobs stay in the README table.

vars.AEROBIM_AUDIT_FAIL_CLOSED: Lab/dev override; forced true under samolet_pilot/production
vars.AEROBIM_BSI_LOCAL_CERT: Development-only local SPF certificate; forced off under pilot/production
vars.AEROBIM_ENFORCE_OBJECT_ACL: Lab/dev override; forced true under samolet_pilot/production
vars.AEROBIM_HYBRID_DRAWING_ENABLED: Internal hybrid drawing path toggle; not an operator claim surface
vars.AEROBIM_MAX_CONCURRENT_ANALYZE_JOBS_PER_: Per-tenant concurrency; baked under pilot when unset
vars.AEROBIM_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES: Envelope ingest cap; typed office/model caps take precedence
vars.AEROBIM_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES_PER_TENANT_DAY: Per-tenant daily ingest budget; baked under pilot when unset
vars.AEROBIM_MAX_UPLOADS_PER_TENANT_DAY: Per-tenant daily upload count; baked under pilot when unset
vars.AEROBIM_MEP_SYSTEM_CLASH_ENABLED: Opt-in engine flag; does not close RT-003
vars.AEROBIM_ODA_CAD_ENABLED: Legal gate only; SDK not shipped (STUB-ODA-CAD-001)
vars.AEROBIM_POSTGRES_APPLY_DDL: Enterprise DML-only runtime after schema applied out of band
vars.AEROBIM_REQUIRE_BSI_SCHEMA: Lab/dev override; forced true under samolet_pilot/production
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_API_BASE_URL: Primary VLM URL; AEROBIM_KIMI_API_BASE_URL is the documented alias
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_API_KEY: Primary VLM key; AEROBIM_KIMI_API_KEY is the documented alias
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_CACHE_DIR: Primary VLM cache dir; AEROBIM_KIMI_CACHE_DIR is the documented alias
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_CACHE_NAMESPACE: Primary VLM cache namespace; KIMI alias is documented
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_CACHE_PROJECT: Primary VLM cache project; KIMI alias is documented
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_CACHE_TTL_DAYS: Primary VLM cache TTL; KIMI alias is documented
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES: Primary VLM image cap; KIMI alias is internal
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_MODEL: Primary VLM model id; AEROBIM_KIMI_MODEL is the documented alias
vars.AEROBIM_VLM_REASONING_EFFORT: Primary VLM reasoning; AEROBIM_KIMI_REASONING_EFFORT is documented
